name: Reporting Waiver Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of regulatory reporting pre-trade waiver.

OILQ.name: Negotiated Transaction In Illiquid Financial Instrument
OILQ.definition: Pre-trade waiver was for a negotiated transaction in illiquid financial instruments. Applicable to equity instruments.

NLIQ.name: Negotiated Transaction In Liquid Financial Instrument
NLIQ.definition: Pre-trade waiver was for a negotiated transaction in liquid financial instruments. Applicable to equity instruments.

PRIC.name: Negotiated Transaction With Conditions
PRIC.definition: Pre-trade waiver was for a negotiated transaction subject to conditions other than the current market price of that financial instruments. Applicable to equity instruments.

ILQD.name: Illiquid Instrument Transaction
ILQD.definition: Pre-trade waiver was for an illiquid instrument transaction. Applicable to non-equity instruments.

RFPT.name: Reference Price Transaction
RFPT.definition: Pre-trade waiver was for a reference price transaction. Applicable to equity instruments.

SIZE.name: Above Specific Size Transaction
SIZE.definition: Pre-trade waiver was for an above specific size transaction. Applicable to non-equity instruments.
